description: HP-81 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) located in Salooni, Chamba district. It serves as a decentralized hub for vehicle registration and driving license issuance within the Salooni sub-division. This office is essential for providing administrative transport services to the mountainous rural communities of the region.
address: Sub Divisional Office, Salooni, District Chamba, Himachal Pradesh
